commit_message: Implement ADR 0153 agent process confinement contract
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0153 agent process confinement
pr_body:
## Summary

- add a truthful provider-neutral confinement request/profile contract at the existing Agent Host process boundary
- keep the generic runtime explicitly application-policy-only and fail closed when provider/OS confinement is required
- derive network scope from existing AgentCapability, preserve loopback MCP/workspace invariants, and persist only non-secret confinement audit data
- expose the selected requirement and actual confinement status in AI Studio
- add fail-closed, loopback, truthfulness, and persistence regression coverage and update ADR 0153 implementation status

## Validation

Run GameEngine Windows Validation and Editor Visual Validation because the security/confinement status UI changes.
